interpretation: The read-only shared filter preserves every sampled P/R bank and every tested n2 cue case; only duplicate B records are removed. Positive moderate weights preserve n2 exposure under within-band sampling. Unconfigured, zero-moderate and seen-history cases change eligibility as documented. Actual later database IDs, inventory, learner histories and configured policy are unavailable; exact live frequencies are not asserted.
rejection: generate has no rejection/resampling loop; it selects offset from nonzero k+offset candidates, derives a bank from distinct eligible divisor/factor pairs, builds and emits each record. No rejection by response role.
